name: SaneSpace: File Manager & Cleaner
summary:
Your Quest is full again, and you don't know why. SaneSpace shows you in one glance.

KNOW YOUR STORAGE
• A live storage map shows where every gigabyte went
• Largest files, file types and file age, sorted for you
• Browse images, videos, audio, documents, APKs and archives by type

CLEAN UP WITHOUT THE FEAR
• One-tap clean for things that are always safe: thumbnail caches, empty folders
• Big files you haven't opened in months, flagged for review, never deleted behind your back
• Everything you delete goes
